scripts.dev:electron: npm run build --workspace packages/electron && electron packages/electron/dist/main.js
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/ui && npm run build --workspace packages/electron
scripts.check: npm run check --workspace packages/ui && npm run check --workspace packages/electron
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace packages/electron && npm run test --workspace packages/ui
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run test:e2e --workspace packages/ui
